title: Monster Opera
summary: Compose three looping chalk-monster tracks, then perform the song forever.
description: Tap twelve animated chalk monsters while the white, yellow, and teal song lines listen, then watch and remix the finished concert on an infinitely scrolling blackboard.
learningGoals: Explore cause and effect by connecting a tap, a sound, and a visible timeline mark
Build an intuitive sense of timing, repetition, and a sixteen-second musical loop
Hear how three contrasting sound layers combine while improvising over a repeating pattern
interactionModel: Tap large monsters to record their four-second sounds at continuous positions on three sequential timelines; tap the finished timeline performers to improvise independent solos.
feedbackModel: Every accepted tap responds with animation, sound, and a traveling chalk token; overlapping repeat taps receive a warm visual wink; there are no wrong answers or failure states.

modes.title: Make a Song
modes.skill: explore timing, layering, and three contrasting sounds

modes.title: Play My Song
modes.skill: hear a self-authored pattern repeat and improvise over it
